notes: Initial preset screening used 1.6 nA for specimen 508378649. That failed spatial refinement and was replaced with a measured 2.0 nA setting. The old scan is retained, not attributed to the changed current.
The revised 2.0 nA setting was not checked at dt 0.0025 ms; no old-current timestep evidence is transferred to it.
Complete-event counts can omit events censored by the end of the 220 ms observation window. Raw crossings and peak/repolarization observations are retained.
The runtime phase offsets of 0–22 ms were not applied to these zero-offset calibrations. The complete interface default is checked separately.
Recorded batch hashes retain the source snapshots at each run. Top-level hashes identify the final report assembly source and final presets; the raw initial selection snapshots intentionally differ.
